transforms.name: GrokConversationNormalizer
transforms.effect: agent_message_chunk appends a non-final assistant message; turn completion finalizes it.

transforms.name: translateAgentEventEnvelope
transforms.effect: Maps the AgentEvent into monitor family updates. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: acceptAgentEvent
transforms.effect: Admits the runtime-plane input. session:exited and process:exited do not clear liveness without host process evidence. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: selectClaims
transforms.effect: Keeps one current claim per family key across the runtime and semantic planes. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: projectAgentMonitorState
transforms.effect: Projects AgentMonitorState. Usage cost is folded here, before the backend builds the row. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: deriveAgentRow
transforms.effect: Copies the projected runtime state onto the host row, applying host defaults.

transforms.name: createMonitorBackend
transforms.effect: fieldd hosts the monitor backend on the runtime source and passes the current-epoch cost reading.

transforms.name: wireMonitorRow
transforms.effect: The model wire drops device.self. This desktop's window otherwise reads the row whole.

transforms.name: peerMonitorRow
transforms.effect: A peer loses project.seq and has detail, activity line, wait text, and reply text bounded.

transforms.name: modelRowFrom
transforms.effect: The reader restores device.self and fills a missing writable from attachable.

transforms.name: window-rows
transforms.effect: No display rewrite for this field. The row is spread through, aside from peer stale and peer profileSet.

applicability.notes: No reader in list, rain, swarm, spend, timeline, or the shared toolkit words. See verification notes. No builtin consumer was proven for this field.

verification.notes: monitor-capabilities.ts declares no conversation family. The reply is still produced by conversation:assistant-message or turn:completed. Declared support for conversation is unknown; the row field is traced. detailLine reads reply.text only. No shipping view reads reply.final. Audit pin is puppeteer 748d015, newer than the 0.3.3 package vibefield ships (tag v0.3.3, commit 52d09c8e). This record does not compare 0.3.3 behavior. A transform effect ending in [post-0.3.3] cites a puppeteer file whose text differs from 52d09c8e.
